text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ayyy~, Tosen Jordan in the house~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A dream? Nah, not really.
I guess I just wanna do something, or like,
I just don't wanna lose...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, pass on the hard stuff for me.
I'd hate to break a nail.
Well, just keep it casual, 'kay~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
